integrity: Analytic proof plus exact-rational finite diagnostic checker. Historical priority qualified by partial text access to the primary preprint and uninspected nonuniform-mesh seminar slides. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only a one-element-per-arm metric star with conforming P1 consistent mass and all degrees retained; no conclusions for subdivided networks, other spaces, or measured solver time. Exact eigenvalue formula is proved for arbitrary positive lengths, and a sharp ratio envelope is attained at balanced four-arm stars.
title: Arithmetic–harmonic contrast controls the complete BRAS spectrum on metric stars
